entry_condition: Study B response-blind relation design PASS, geographic-opportunity geometry PASS, and development synthetic qualification PASS_TO_CONFIRMATORY_CHARACTER_MASK_PREPARATION at alpha=0.025.

panel.role: confirmatory panel only; development genetic response remains permanently closed

allowed_view: For every aligned FASTA character reveal and persist only canonical-valid versus noncanonical/missing: A/C/G/T -> 1; every other symbol -> 0. Nucleotide identity must not persist.

edge_admissibility.valid_sequence_pair: jointly canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)
edge_admissibility.valid_frozen_edge: at least one valid cross-locality sequence pair exists between the two unchanged frozen graph endpoint localities
edge_admissibility.failed_species: drop species from the Study B confirmatory estimand; do not rewire, switch marker, delete sequences, or relax threshold

post_mask_dyad_support.unsupported_target: drop from the confirmatory dyad estimand without replacement
post_mask_dyad_support.no_absolute_cluster_minimum: Exact survivor-geometry Type-I/power requalification is the binding adequacy gate; no cluster-count threshold may be invented after mask opening.

required_survivor_requalification.failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_B_CHARACTER_MASK_OR_SURVIVOR_GEOMETRY; proceed to already-frozen Study C without changing B or C

forbidden: inspect Study B nucleotide identity before exact survivor requalification passes
change the 0.50 comparable-site threshold after mask opening
retain duplicate-header species by changing the reader
change R_env, PCA axes, KDE, geography threshold, lineage controls, alpha, or synthetic positive-control floor after mask opening
convert mask or requalification failure into a biological null
